name: com.quickactions.testlib
description: Testbed fixture, not a shipped package. CI's android-build job requires its drawable ic_quickaction_frompkg in the 2022.3 APK, which is the ROADMAP's sub-item (d): does an .androidlib shipped inside a package reach the build the same way one under Assets/ does?
